aiTitle: Add iOS home screen instructions for notifications

content.text:
Looks good. The change is in place. Here's what was added:

- `isIOS` state — tracks whether the device is iOS regardless of standalone mode (so we can show the right error even for users who have added the app to the home screen but push still fails, e.g. older iOS versions).
- `subscriptionError` state — set to `true` when `subscribeToNotifications()` returns false.
- After a failed button click on iOS, shows the same step-by-step home screen instructions ("Teilen-Symbol → Zum Home-Bildschirm → App öffnen → Benachrichtigungen aktivieren") as a labeled error block.
- On non-iOS devices, shows a simple German error message instead.

The existing proactive detection (`isIOSBrowser`) still shows the instructions immediately when the app is opened in iOS Safari without being installed, so users typically see the guidance before even clicking anything.
